verdict.rationale: Slack documents an official MCP server (docs.slack.dev/ai/slack-mcp-server/) exposing tools for search, messaging, canvases, lists, and file uploads, with admin approval controls for MCP client integrations, and a live hands-on probe confirms the remote endpoint at api.slack.com/mcp is reachable and auth-gated as expected. This directly satisfies the story of connecting an agent to Slack via an official MCP server. Missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of real-world agent connections and more detail on the connection/auth flow beyond the token-gated handshake.
